steps.js: 'boom '+(()=>{const g=__dmh,P=g.player;__take(30);const es=__spawn(3,1e6,true);__shoot();const o=[];let caught=-1;for(let k=0;k<200;k++){__sim(1);for(const E of es){E.pos.x=E.home.x;E.pos.z=E.home.z;}if(!P.slot.sg.out&&caught<0)caught=k;}return JSON.stringify({d:__dmg(es),caught,keep:P.slot.sg.keep})})()

'bow '+(()=>{const g=__dmh,P=g.player;__take(34);const es=__spawn(1,1e6,true);const E=es[0];const o=[];for(const hold of [10,46,90]){P.yaw=0;P.pitch=0;P.reloading=false;P.slot.ammo=1;P.fireCd=0;__sim(3);const h=E.health;for(let k=0;k<hold;k++){__sim(1,{fire:true});E.pos.x=E.home.x;E.pos.z=E.home.z;}const dr=(P.slot.sg.draw||0).toFixed(2);__sim(30);o.push([hold,dr,Math.round(h-E.health),P.slot.reserve]);__sim(40);}return JSON.stringify(o)})()

'mirror '+(()=>{const g=__dmh,P=g.player;__take(36);const es=__spawn(1,1e6,true);let legs=0;const o=P.fireHitscan.bind(P);P.fireHitscan=function(){legs++;return o(...arguments)};__shoot();delete P.fireHitscan;return JSON.stringify({legs,dmg:__dmg(es)})})()

'calliope '+(()=>{const g=__dmh,P=g.player;__take(37);const es=__spawn(2,1e6,true);const o=[];for(let s=0;s<6;s++){P.yaw=0;P.pitch=0;P.slot.ammo=8;P.fireCd=0;P.fireWeapon();o.push(P.slot.sg.combo);__sim(30);for(const E of es){E.pos.x=E.home.x;E.pos.z=E.home.z;}}__sim(10);P.fireCd=0;P.fireWeapon();o.push('off:'+P.slot.sg.combo);return JSON.stringify({o,dmg:__dmg(es)})})()

'lariat '+(()=>{const g=__dmh,P=g.player;__take(38);const es=__spawn(3,1e6,false);const V=P.pos.constructor;for(const E of es){P.yaw=Math.atan2(-(E.pos.x-P.pos.x),-(E.pos.z-P.pos.z));P.pitch=0;__sim(2);P.fireCd=0;P.reloading=false;P.fireWeapon();__sim(3);}const h=es.map(e=>e.health);P.dealDamage(es[0],1000,es[0].pos,new V(0,0,-1),false,0,true);return JSON.stringify({herd:(P.sgHerd||[]).length,lost:es.map((e,k)=>Math.round(h[k]-e.health))})})()

'saw '+(()=>{const g=__dmh,P=g.player;__take(41);const es=__spawn(1,1e6,true);const E=es[0];const o=[];for(let s=0;s<3;s++){const h=E.health,hp=P.health;__shoot();o.push([Math.round(hp),Math.round(h-E.health)]);__sim(20);E.pos.x=E.home.x;E.pos.z=E.home.z;}P.health=40;const h=E.health;__shoot();o.push(['low',Math.round(h-E.health)]);const w=__spawn(1,20,true)[0];w.pos.copy(E.pos);P.health=40;P.dealDamage;return JSON.stringify(o)})()

'tilt '+(()=>{const g=__dmh,P=g.player;__take(42);const es=__spawn(5,1e6,true);__shoot();let mx=0;for(let k=0;k<200;k++){__sim(1);for(const E of es){E.pos.x=E.home.x;E.pos.z=E.home.z;}mx=Math.max(mx,g.projectiles.list.filter(q=>!q.done&&q.kind==='Ball').length);}return JSON.stringify({dmg:__dmg(es),maxBalls:mx})})()
